verdict.rationale: Docs show pre-mapped controls, policy/evidence workflows, continuous monitoring, audit partner selection, and a SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and actions policies/risks/evidence — covering the SOC 2 program lifecycle from setup to audit readiness. Missing for 10: explicit mapping to the five Trust Services Criteria, explicit Type I vs Type II workflow differentiation, and independent/hands-on corroboration of a completed SOC 2 audit cycle.
